Open Items to Close
Everything below is unresolved as of September 4 and needs an answer before or during production week. Grouped by who the next action sits with.
Awaiting Building / Owner Sign-Off
Pending
Elevator isolation. Freight elevator is confirmed for dedicated load-in/out windows. Isolating all 4 passenger elevators for the 200-guest VIP flow (verbally offered by the owner on the site visit) still needs written building confirmation.
Pending
Rooftop alcohol & DJ — building sign-off. Owner indicated on site visits this has been done before (referencing past events running with DJ/bar until 5am) — but this contradicts an earlier internal read that rooftop liquor service wasn't allowed per Mayor's Office guidelines. Still needs a direct, written confirmation with the building ahead of the 8:30–10:30pm rooftop DJ set.
Confirmed
Liquor permit. Obtained. This is separate from the building sign-off above, which still needs to close out.
Pending
Freight-lift hallway as guest entry point. Using the hallway as BOH staging is not possible (shared with other tenants). Using it as a post-7pm guest access route remains on the table, pending building confirmation.
Awaiting Vendor / Quote Confirmation
In Progress
Floor protection — Thursday times. Vendor confirmed (NY Layout Pros). Monday install (2pm) and first removal (~8–10pm) are set. Thursday's second install (AM) and removal (PM) are intentionally left open — exact times not yet confirmed.
In Progress
JDAV / Emcee rooftop AV quote. Quote requested for (1) rooftop electrical work, (2) DJ equipment transfer to/from the roof, (3) on-site sound technician for event day. Awaiting JDAV's written proposal.
In Progress
Rail / mannequin vendor contact. Building ownership is coordinating this vendor directly for Sep 7 & 10 (4–10pm). Cocoon doesn't have a name or phone number yet — needed for Nafisa's on-site list. Scope now spans the Corridor, Zone 1, and Zone 2 (see the Visual Guide, p.5) — confirm they know about the Zone 2 addition.
Awaiting Client Info / Decision
In Progress
COIs — a handful of fixes left. Most are in and approved: B Concept, Frank Glover Productions, Great Performances, LUXE EVENT DECOR RENTALS NJ, and Pegasus are all "Looks Great." Still need small corrections: Polar Black's own COI (missing the Insured Box), AISAM Inc and Party Rental LTD (missing waiver of subrogation + additional-insured boxes), and RNS NYC LLC (needs 401 Broadway added to the certificate holder box). OTI's and Cavas's own COI status still needs checking.
In Progress
Wall-hanging. Building will not approve drilled holes — command strips are the confirmed path forward (Polar Black has raised one more objection preferring screws, unresolved). Spotlights proposed to hang via clear zip ties on the pipe instead (non-damaging), pending final building sign-off.
Pending
Additional BOH space. Cocoon is still sourcing this; not yet secured.
In Progress
WiFi. Three named/passworded networks + 2-Gig upgrade requested, but Verizon's earliest appointment is after the event — won't be ready in time. Cocoon is looking for another path. A hard-wired line at the venue can carry the livestream instead; Cocoon still owes Polar Black its exact physical location.
In Progress
Late pickup — mannequin vendor. ~50 boxes / 2 truckloads (Frank Glover) can't be collected the night of the event. Polar Black's own live schedule now places this collection late Sept 9 (12–1am window) rather than Sept 10 morning, but still marks Frank Glover as TBC there — exact list, vendor and window still need confirming.
⚑ Schedule Flags to Confirm
Sept 8, 11:30am — second mannequin truck. Marked "to confirm" on Polar Black's own live production schedule. Please confirm this delivery is locked before load-in day.

Sept 8 — Moe's team assignment. This deck originally listed Moe under Cocoon's 7:45am Casa Manager coverage. Polar Black's live schedule lists Moe as their own coordinator instead. Flagged for confirmation — see the Sept 8 page and Team & Contacts.

Furniture removal / reset dates — confirmed directly in this ticket as September 7 (removal) and September 10 (reset). Treat these two dates as the standing plan.
